goalTranslation.businessGoal: Answer, research, and organize a user's owner-scoped notebook with a bounded, approval-gated agent that reaches Notion-parity behavior on free routed models.

quantifiedTarget.rationale: convex/modelRouting.ts saveBenchmark promotes a model only when it passes all six NODEAGENT_PARITY_CASES (passedCases === totalCases).

decomposition: semantic hydration: embed query and pending notes, fuse retrieved context (retrievalFusion.ts)
bounded investigation: at most four tool steps (workflowAgent.ts MAX_INVESTIGATION_STEPS)
final synthesis with structured output (RESULT_JSON_SCHEMA, strict json_schema)
proposal review: graph operations land as a pending proposal, never applied inline

tiers.action: ask-mode read-only answers over notebook context
auto-apply graph operations within the bounded operation budget (create_node, update_node_content, move_node, non-author add_relation)

delete_node, clone_node_hierarchy, author add_relation, or operation count above MAX_AUTO_OPERATIONS (workflowAgent.ts assessOperationRisk) — disposition approval_required; the run records a pending proposal with digest and riskReasons and stops
plan executionMode — every operation set becomes preview_only regardless of risk

interception.how: src/app/api/query/route.ts catches every failure, records a durable failed-run receipt (status failed, message truncated to 500 chars), reports model outcome, and returns a bounded generic message with an honest non-2xx status (409 conflict / 422 insufficient nodes / 502 otherwise).

fallback.description: When embeddings fail, retrieval degrades to lexical context with an explicit retrievalStatus of degraded plus reason surfaced in the response; when the provider fails after retries, the user receives an honest failed status with a durable failed-run receipt instead of fabricated output.

slos.rationale: Enforced bound: convex/modelRouting.ts promotes only models passing all six parity cases.
Enforced bound: MAX_AGENT_TOTAL_TOKENS fuse (src/app/api/query/route.ts:42) fails closed with AGENT_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.
Enforced bound: PROVIDER_DEADLINE_MS (route.ts:41) reserves ten seconds of the 120s platform budget for durable receipts and an honest failure response.

circuitBreaker.onTrip: Three consecutive provider failures (FAILURE_TRIGGER, convex/modelRouting.ts modelFailureTransition) automatically schedule a re-benchmark and re-route; reruns are rate-limited to once per hour (MIN_RERUN_INTERVAL_MS).

costFuse.onTrip: The run aborts with AGENT_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED before the next provider call (workflowAgent.ts token accounting against maxTotalTokens), and the failure is recorded as a durable failed receipt — the fuse fails closed.

judgeRegression.command: yarn ci-tests (lint + typecheck + jest, including the rule-based judge suites: scoreParityResult in convex/modelRouting.ts and scoreLiveEval in src/app/api/query/evals/liveEval.ts)

modelMigration.pinnedModel: gpt-5-mini (env.AGENT_MODEL default, src/envBackend.ts:44; overridable only via the AGENT_MODEL environment variable)
modelMigration.migrationEvalCommand: convex internal action modelRouting:benchmarkFreeModels — runs the six NODEAGENT_PARITY_CASES against each candidate; promotion to primaryModel requires every case passing, otherwise the previous route is retained

tracing.field: runId (client requestId or fresh UUID; used as traceId through the provider step journal, workflow receipt, proposal id, and eval receipt)
